thread:
maria: Quick flag from the quarterly least-privilege pass 1 principals have KMS:Decrypt via an old onboarding role 'ops-onboard-v2' that was recently templated. looks like a wildcard member slipped in (serviceAccount:*-bot@*) and applied broadly.

evan: can you paste the IAM diff?

maria: pasted: ```diff
- members: ["serviceAccount:my-service@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
+ members: ["serviceAccount:*bot@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
```

sofia: yikes. that pattern matches multiple vendor agents. how did the module allow that?

tariq: root cause: onboarding module permitted pattern variables and hadn't validated for KMS-scoped roles. the module authoring task used a permissive template.

infra-bot: [automated] drift-detect PD-2026-700: wildcard serviceAccount binding on KMS roles. emitting policy_diff and affected_keys list.

sec-bot: incident INC-2026-900 opened: "Wildcard SA binding exposed KMS decrypt to multiple principals". Priority: P2.

evan: immediate mitigation: list affected principals, quarantine keys by adding conditional deny binding, and start a key rotation plan. i'll run a canary rotation for one key.

maria: also we have a gap in audit ingestion for one shard around 2026-07-09T12:30Z-13:15Z; need to confirm whether any of the 21 principals used a key in that window. if logs missing, we'll need attestation + JIT flow.

sofia: scripts: audit_expose.sh to enumerate principals and last_decrypt:
```bash
./tools/audit_expose.sh --role ops-onboard-v2 --since 2026-06-01 --until 2026-07-15
```

sofia: output shows 9 principals with recent decrypts, 12 with no recent activity.

tariq: vendor-ops, please confirm owner contacts for the vendor SAs. if no owner evidence, we rotate keys and restrict roles to kms-reader. vendor-ops: ping.

vendor-ops: received. we'll search onboarding PRs and escalate to vendor integrators. ETA 4h.

evan: starting canary rotation rot-20260715-01 on key projects/redwood/kr/main-key. monitoring app errors for 30m.

infra-bot: replay_job rp-20260709-01 queued to backfill shard logs for 2026-07-09T12:30Z..2026-07-09T13:15Z. note: cold retrieval may be needed.

maria: policy change proposal: for any role granting KMS decrypt, the entitlement-sweeper must require explicit ownerproof OR an attestation link before auto-removal, and onboarding modules must reject wildcard principals for KMS-scoped roles. i'll open INFRA PR.

sofia: propose short-term rule: mark any principal granted via wildcard as 'requires-manual-review' and pause auto-prune. also add metric `entitlement.wildcard_kms_bindings` and alert.

sec-bot: [automated] compliance flag: wildcard KMS bindings are classified as high risk for SOC2 checklist. attach to INC-2026-900.

infra-bot: replay rp-20260709-01 status=success files=1,012 bytes=1.2GB. collector run cr-20260709-05 recovered 7 decrypt events mapping to 3 principals. remaining 18 principals lack direct audit events in that window.

evan: for the 3 active principals, validate whether decrypts were legitimate (service owner confirmation + PR link). for the rest, start owner attestation emails using template runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/owner-attest-wildcard.

tariq: i'll open PR to harden onboarding templates: forbid pattern chars '*' and '?' in member inputs for roles tagged sensitive:kms. PR #infra-224.

maria: action list: 1) rotate and quarantine affected keys (evan) 2) pause sweeper auto-removals for these principals (sofia) 3) onboarding module patch (tariq) 4) vendor attestation (vendor-ops) 5) attach replay+collector evidence to INC-2026-900 (maria).

vendor-ops: vendor provided two PRs showing explicit SA creation times for 4 principals; attaching links. others pending.

maria: note for compliance: root cause = permissive onboarding template + insufficient sweeper gate for KMS roles. remediation = onboarding PR, sweeper policy change, replay backfill, key rotation, and an attestation fallback. will draft postmortem and share.

evan: can we add a synthetic test in CI that rejects any terraform plan with wildcard SA on KMS roles? would prevent reintro.

tariq: yes, adding a pre-merge policy check in terraform-ci. PR #infra-225.

maria: good work. keeping entitlement removals on hold for these principals until attestation or rotation complete. reconvene in 6h for status. :thumbsup:
